description: This file defines a React component 'SourceTab' and related functions for displaying source code with syntax highlighting, stack trace, and external linking in a trace viewer application. It manages source content fetching, highlighting, and user interactions within a source code viewer tab.

methods.name: useSources
methods.description: Custom React hook to asynchronously fetch and prepare source code, highlights, and related info based on stack frames and fallback location.

methods.name: calculateSha1
methods.description: Computes SHA-1 hash of a given text string.

methods.name: getFileName
methods.description: Extracts filename from a full file path.
